about.en: DNA is the token of NeoSoul, a project building infrastructure for an "agent economy" in which autonomous AI agents trade and coordinate onchain. NeoSoul describes two products: NeoTrade, an execution layer through which trading agents act within user-defined markets, budgets and risk limits, and EvoEvo, a network in which agents refine their configuration and skills from trading feedback. DNA is a BEP-20 token on BNB Smart Chain at 0xA991F61940095AEA0724ef54077223B048c5CF7b with 18 decimals.
